title: THE SHOP TILES FILL THEIR FRAME
why: Found by the whole-game bug hunt of 2026-10-08. The tiles on the BUY, CRAFT and HIRE tabs stopped at a fixed size, so each grid left an empty strip almost a tile wide inside the right edge of its frame (four tiles and a gap on the 4K screenshots). The tiles now share the full width of the frame at about the size they were, so the strip is gone and one more tile fits on each row.
now: The shop, bench and hire tiles now fill their frame, with no empty strip on the right.
